label: airFiber 5U
description: 5.9/6 GHz high-band airFiber radio with integrated 30 dBi dish, 1.2+ Gbps throughput and 100+ km range, 40 W max, 50 V 4-pair passive PoE. Ports: 1x GbE data RJ45 + 1x 10/100 MbE management RJ45 and an RJ-12 alignment-tone port; operating 5725-6200 MHz depending on region.
